infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Logistel Driver collects location data to display navigation and route maps to active pickup and drop-off points.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: Logistel Driver collects location data in the background to transmit package movement updates to dispatchers and customers even when the app is minimized.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysUsageDescription: Logistel Driver requires background location access to transmit continuous package tracking telemetry to dispatchers.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Logistel Driver requires camera access to capture proof-of-delivery photos and scan package bar codes.

plugins.locationAlwaysAndWhenInUsePermission: Logistel Driver collects background location data to send package telemetry to dispatchers even when minimized.

plugins.cameraPermission: Logistel Driver requires camera access for proof-of-delivery photos.
